summary_md: **CleanSlop ([@CleanSlop](https://x.com/CleanSlop/status/2115555853998989573))** open-sourced the **CleanSlop CLI**, the tool a coding agent runs to scan a repo and fix findings: MIT, zero runtime dependencies, with signed npm provenance.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - cleanslop/cli: Readiness scans from your coding agent. The CLI starts a CleanSlop scan of your repo, waits for it, and hands the report back so the agent can fix what it finds. Published as @cleanslop/cli (bin cleanslop).

relevance: An agent-invoked repo scanner designed to be auditable.
